import torch

from src.mythosmini.hardware.autotune import (
    BatchPlan,
    autotune_batch_size,
    probe_throughput,
    shrink_after_oom,
)
from src.mythosmini.hardware.detect import (
    autocast_dtype,
    describe_device,
    detect_device,
    refresh_free_memory,
)


def test_detect_device_returns_consistent_info() -> None:
    info = detect_device()
    assert info.device in ("cuda", "cpu")
    assert info.cpu_threads >= 1
    assert describe_device(info)
    if info.device == "cuda":
        assert info.free_memory_bytes > 0
        assert refresh_free_memory(info) > 0
    else:
        assert refresh_free_memory(info) == 0


def test_autocast_dtype_matches_capability() -> None:
    info = detect_device()
    dtype = autocast_dtype(info)
    if info.device == "cuda" and info.supports_bf16:
        assert dtype == torch.bfloat16
    else:
        assert dtype == torch.float32


def test_shrink_after_oom_decrements_by_five_and_compensates() -> None:
    plan = BatchPlan(micro_batch=64, grad_accum=1)
    shrunk = shrink_after_oom(plan)
    assert shrunk.micro_batch == 59
    assert shrunk.grad_accum == 2
    assert shrunk.effective_batch >= plan.effective_batch


def test_shrink_after_oom_never_drops_below_one() -> None:
    plan = BatchPlan(micro_batch=3, grad_accum=4)
    shrunk = shrink_after_oom(plan)
    assert shrunk.micro_batch == 1
    assert shrunk.effective_batch >= 12


def test_probe_throughput_returns_none_on_oom() -> None:
    def exploding_step(batch_size: int) -> None:
        raise torch.OutOfMemoryError("simulated out of memory")

    assert probe_throughput(exploding_step, 8, 512, "cpu") is None


def test_autotune_batch_size_picks_fastest_real_step() -> None:
    info = detect_device()
    weights = torch.randn(64, 64, device=info.device)

    def real_step(batch_size: int) -> None:
        data = torch.randn(batch_size, 64, device=info.device)
        (data @ weights).sum().backward() if False else (data @ weights).sum().item()

    plan = autotune_batch_size(real_step, seq_len=64, info=info)
    assert plan.micro_batch >= 1
    assert plan.grad_accum == 1
